In the "memos" Go codebase (working dir /bench/repo), trace webhook / outbound HTTP delivery.

Context: internal/webhook/webhook.go and internal/webhook/validate.go implement outbound webhooks. server/router/api/v1/ holds gRPC/RPC handler methods.

TASK 1 (convergence): Find the single function where all webhook delivery converges before the actual outbound HTTP request executes. Give its name and path:line. Also identify the exact function/line where the HTTP request is sent (e.g. http.Client.Do / Post).

TASK 2 (SSRF protection): What protects the outbound webhook from being pointed at internal network addresses (SSRF protection)? Look in internal/webhook/validate.go and internal/httpgetter/. Give the protection mechanism and path:line.

TASK 3 (handlers → webhook, multi-hop): Which RPC handler methods in server/router/api/v1/ can transitively cause an outbound webhook HTTP request to a user-configured URL? A memo create/update/delete triggers webhooks. Trace the call chain from handler methods (e.g. CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoResources, etc.) down to the webhook dispatch function. Name at least 3-4 concrete handler methods (with path:line) and show the intermediate dispatch function they all funnel through (e.g. something like DispatchMemoRelatedWebhook). 

Report the full call chain with path:line citations at each hop. Be precise and exhaustive.

content.text:
I now have the complete trace. Here are my findings.

## TASK 1 — Convergence + actual HTTP send

**Convergence function:** `webhook.Post` — `/bench/repo/internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`

Every webhook delivery funnels through `Post`. The async path (`PostAsync`, line 184) just enqueues onto `asyncPostQueue`; the 4 worker goroutines started in `init()` (line 42-54) all call `Post(payload)` at line 46. There is no other outbound path — synchronous and async both converge on `Post`.

**Actual outbound HTTP request is sent at:** `/bench/repo/internal/webhook/webhook.go:152`
```go
resp, err := safeClient.Do(req)
```
`safeClient` is the shared `*http.Client` defined at line 32 whose `Transport.DialContext = safeDialContext`.

## TASK 2 — SSRF protection

Two layers protect the webhook path, both keyed on `isReservedIP` (`/bench/repo/internal/webhook/validate.go:44`), which checks the resolved IP against `reservedNetworks` (parsed from `reservedCIDRs` at lines 14-23: IPv4 loopback, RFC-1918 ranges, 169.254.0.0/16 link-local/cloud IMDS, and IPv6 ::1, fc00::/7, fe80::/10).

1. **Admission-time validation** — `webhook.ValidateURL` (`/bench/repo/internal/webhook/validate.go:62`): parses the URL, enforces http/https scheme, resolves the hostname (`net.LookupHost`, line 71) and rejects any reserved/private IP (line 78). Called when a user creates/updates a webhook config (`user_service_webhooks.go:74,161,182`).

2. **Dial-time enforcement (the real SSRF guard)** — `safeDialContext` (`/bench/repo/internal/webhook/webhook.go:59`), wired into `safeClient.Transport.DialContext`. On every dial it re-resolves the host (line 65) and rejects reserved IPs (line 71-73). This is what defeats **DNS rebinding** and TOCTOU between validation and delivery, since the check happens at connection time.

An escape hatch exists: `AllowPrivateIPs` (`validate.go:41`); when true, `isReservedIP` short-circuits to `false` (line 45), disabling both layers for self-hosted LAN targets.

Note on `internal/httpgetter/`: `http_getter.go` is an empty stub. The httpgetter package does have its own **parallel but separate** SSRF protection (`secureDialContext`/`resolveAllowedIPs`/`isInternalIP` in `html_meta.go:51-90`, plus a redirect re-validator at line 39-47) — but that guards **link-preview / HTML-metadata fetching**, not the webhook delivery path. The webhook path does not use httpgetter.

## TASK 3 — Handler → webhook call chains (multi-hop)

All memo webhooks funnel through the intermediate dispatch function **`(*APIV1Service).dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`** (`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:48`), which loops user webhooks and calls `webhook.PostAsync(payload)` at **line 71**. (The comment-created variant `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` at line 30 calls `PostAsync` directly at line 43.)

`PostAsync` (`webhook.go:184`) → `asyncPostQueue` → worker `Post` (`webhook.go:46`) → `safeClient.Do` (`webhook.go:152`).

Concrete RPC handlers that transitively reach an outbound webhook to a user-configured URL:

**1. CreateMemo** — `memo_service.go:70`
→ `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` (`memo_service.go:157`)
→ `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:16` → `:48`)
→ `webhook.PostAsync` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:71`)

**2. UpdateMemo** — `memo_service.go:401`
→ `buildUpdatedMemoState` + `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (`memo_service.go:506,513`)
→ `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (`memo_update_helpers.go:66`) → `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` (`memo_update_helpers.go:67`)
→ `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:20` → `:48`)
→ `webhook.PostAsync` (`:71`)

**3. DeleteMemo** — `memo_service.go:518`
→ `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` (`memo_service.go:562`)
→ `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:25` → `:48`)
→ `webhook.PostAsync` (`:71`)

**4. CreateMemoComment** — `memo_service_comments.go:20`
→ `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (`memo_service_comments.go:119`)
→ (`memo_service_webhooks.go:30`) → `webhook.PostAsync` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:43`)
Note: this handler also internally calls `CreateMemo` (`memo_service_comments.go:37`, i.e. line 20+37) — but with `withSuppressSSE`; the parent-memo `memos.memo.comment.created` webhook is the intended dispatch.

**5. SetMemoAttachments** — `memo_attachment_service.go:16`
→ `touchMemoUpdatedTimestamp` + `buildUpdatedMemoState` + `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (`memo_attachment_service.go:41,44,48`)
→ `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (`memo_update_helpers.go:66`) → `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` (`:67`)
→ `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`:48`) → `PostAsync` (`:71`)

**6. SetMemoRelations** — `memo_relation_service.go:16`
→ `touchMemoUpdatedTimestamp` + `buildUpdatedMemoState` + `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (`memo_relation_service.go:41,44,48`)
→ same tail as above → `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` → `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` → `PostAsync` (`:71`)

So six handlers reach the webhook dispatch, all converging (except the comment case, which dispatches directly) on `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` → `PostAsync` → worker `Post` → `safeClient.Do`. `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (`memo_update_helpers.go:66`) is the shared intermediate for the three "update-shaped" handlers (UpdateMemo, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations).
